# The worktree keeps switching around every status collection and never
# settles. gitmux must exhaust its bounded re-sampling attempts, output no
# (mixed) summary, stay silent without -dbg and print the error with -dbg.

exec /usr/bin/git init -q
exec /usr/bin/git checkout -q -b main
exec /usr/bin/git config user.email tester@example.com
exec /usr/bin/git config user.name Tester
exec /usr/bin/git add f
exec /usr/bin/git commit -q -m one
exec /usr/bin/git branch zzother
exec /usr/bin/git add f2
exec /usr/bin/git commit -q -m two
exec /usr/bin/git checkout -q zzother
exec /usr/bin/git add g
exec /usr/bin/git commit -q -m three
exec /usr/bin/git checkout -q main

cd $GITMUX_DIR
go build -o $WORK/gitmux .
cd $WORK

chmod 0755 bin/git
env PATH=$WORK/bin:$PATH

# -dbg: non-zero exit, nothing on stdout (no mixed summary), error on stderr.
! exec ./gitmux -dbg
cp stdout fail.out
cp stderr fail.err
! exec /usr/bin/grep -q . fail.out
exec /usr/bin/grep -qi unstable fail.err

# Silent mode: non-zero exit with empty stdout AND empty stderr.
! exec ./gitmux
cp stdout silent.out
cp stderr silent.err
! exec /usr/bin/grep -q . silent.out
! exec /usr/bin/grep -q . silent.err

-- bin/git --
#!/bin/sh
# Flaps main -> zzother around every 'git status' invocation, so each
# collection round straddles a switch and generations never settle.
if [ "$1" = "status" ]; then
	/usr/bin/git checkout -q main
	/usr/bin/git "$@" > .gmsw_out
	rc=$?
	/usr/bin/git checkout -q zzother
	/bin/cat .gmsw_out
	exit $rc
fi
exec /usr/bin/git "$@"

-- f --
one
-- f2 --
two
-- g --
three
